title: Detecting Silent Faults at the Environment-Trainer Boundary in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.08144v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot reinforcement learning increasingly runs environments outside the trainer: in another process, on another machine, in another language. Many faults at this boundary raise no error. We make the boundary a wire protocol and ask what notices a fault in it.   On Pendulum, HalfCheetah, Hopper and a 7-joint arm (Pusher), we injected up to 23 faults into what crosses the wire and 2 into the trainer's log, from one value to every value. Unless every value was wrong, a learning-curve threshold caught at most one run in ten, and a comparison with ten fault-free seeds at most 21%. A clean evaluation of all 1,060 final policies agreed with the curves: of the 728 boundary-fault runs both curve checks passed, 723 scored no more than three standard deviations below fault-free seeds, though nearly all ended on other weights and, for reward faults, logged other returns.   Checks of the run itself, not of its outcome, saw every fault. A step ledge

translated_title: 强化学习中环境-训练器边界处的静默故障检测
translated_abstract: 机器人强化学习越来越多地在训练器之外运行环境：在另一个进程中、在另一台机器上、使用另一种编程语言。这种边界上的许多故障不会引发任何错误报告。我们将该边界建模为一种线协议，并探究是什么能够察觉到其中发生的故障。在 Pendulum、HalfCheetah、Hopper 和一个 7 关节机械臂上，我们向跨越线路传输的数据中注入了多达 23 种故障，并向训练器的日志中注入了 2 种故障，范围从单个值出错到全部值出错。除非每个值都是错误的，否则基于学习曲线阈值的检查最多只能发现十分之一的故障运行，与十个无故障种子对比的检查最多发现 21%。对所有 1,060 个最终策略的干净评估与曲线检查结果一致：在 728 个边界故障运行中，两种曲线检查均通过，其中 723 个的得分不比无故障种子低超过三个标准差，尽管几乎所有运行最终都收敛到了不同的权重，而且对于奖励类故障，记录的回报值也与正常情况不同。而对运行过程本身（而非其结果）的检查则发现了每一个故障。一个步进台阶……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现强化学习中环境与训练器边界处的静默故障几乎无法通过学习曲线等基于结果的检查发现，而直接检查运行过程中跨越边界传输的数据本身则能检测到每一个注入的故障。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that silent faults at the environment-trainer boundary in reinforcement learning are largely missed by outcome-based checks like learning-curve thresholds, while inspecting the run itself—what crosses the wire—detects every injected fault.
